notes.title: Demo release
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings all![/h2]

We're thrilled to announce the release of the [b][i]Wings of Redemption[/i][/b] demo, and we want YOU to be a crucial part of this exciting journey! 🌟

🔍 Why a Demo?
We believe in the power of community and collaboration, and we want to invite you to test-drive our game before the official launch. Your insights and feedback are invaluable in helping us shape [b][i]Wings of Redemption[/i][/b] into an unforgettable gaming experience.

🛠️ How Can You Help?
Play the demo, explore the world we've crafted, and share your thoughts! Whether it's bug reports, gameplay suggestions, or just telling us what you love, your feedback is a vital piece of the development puzzle.

🚀 How to Join the Feedback Initiative:
Visit our [url=https://discord.gg/fBNPCwEaFu]Discord[/url] to share your thoughts, report bugs, suggest improvements and connect with fellow gamers.

Let's make [b][i]Wings of Redemption[/i][/b] the best it can be together! Your adventure begins now.

Thank you for being part of our incredible community!

Your [b]Nukeborn[/b] Studio
